name: Dynamo0C
author: NL Sounds
description: Console-style 4-band parametric EQ — an LV2 plugin for Linux with its own hardware-style UI
changes: The sound is untouched — DSP is byte-for-byte the same as 1.1.0. Panel rebuilt with proper bevels, glows, and softer engage/bypass fades. CPU usage for open plugin windows cut ~64x. Fixed letter-spacing rendering, blurry knobs on HiDPI, and a potential crash in make install.
